title: Vibrant V-Band Flange Assembly
description:
Designed for leak-free, high-pressure exhaust and boosted applications, the Vibrant Performance V-Band Flange Assembly provides a secure, modular connection without requiring gaskets. Ideal for custom turbo downpipes, wastegate dumps, intercooler piping, and modular exhaust setups.

Featuring a male/female interlocking flange design, these assemblies align perfectly during welding to prevent warping and ensure a smooth, inner exhaust transition. The included quick-release stainless steel clamp allows for rapid teardown and servicing at the track or in the shop.

#### Key Features:

* Gasketless Seal: Male/female recess interlocking design ensures a leak-proof seal even under high exhaust temperatures and boost pressure.
* Quick-Release Latch: Heavy-duty stainless steel T-bolt clamp allows for fast disassembly during maintenance or trackside repairs.
* T304 Stainless Construction: Corrosion-resistant materials built to handle extreme thermal cycling on street, drag, and track builds.
* Precision Fitment: CNC-machined weld flanges ensure clean, easy TIG welding onto tubing.

#### Specs:

* Flange Material: T304 Stainless Steel (or 6061 Billet Aluminum depending on application)
* Clamp Style: Quick-Release Stainless Steel T-Bolt
* Installation: Weld-on universal fitment
